name: Hyakka Ryoran Master Samurai Chronicles
storyline: In the alternate early 21st century of the Hyakka Ryoran setting, the Tokugawa Shogunate has retained political power into the modern era, and student councils under Tokugawa influence enforce strict control over education and society. Yagyu Muneakira, a Yagyu Dojo instructor and student at Buou Gakuen Juku, opposes the Tokugawa student council's suppression of the anti-establishment Toyotomi faction. When several girls bearing the names of legendary samurai appear before him, Muneakira learns he can awaken their Master Samurai powers through a contract, and gathers a party of allies to resist the oppressive faction and uncover the source of the Master Samurai lineage.
summary: Turn-based idle role-playing browser game adaptation of the Hyakka Ryoran Samurai Girls light novel series by Akira Suzuki. Players take the role of Yagyu Muneakira, a Buou Gakuen Juku student who possesses the ability to awaken Master Samurai powers in others, and lead a party of Master Samurai based on historical figures such as Yagyu Jubei, Sanada Yukimura, Tokugawa Sen, and Date Masamune. The game features a five-member auto-battle party with tap-based Spirit intervention from Muneakira. Materials collected in idle combat feed into a Katana equipment system and cosmetic Skin loadouts. Operated by CTW, Inc. on the G123 platform since July 3, 2026.
